capabilities: Toggle hiding of the sidebars on and off
Control the toggle from a leaf-shaped ribbon icon
extras: README includes developer instructions for building and installing manually from the repository.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click control to hide both sidebars at once for a distraction-free view.
summary: Sidebar toggle plugin that lets you quickly hide and show Obsidian's left and right sidebars from a ribbon icon.
